evals.prompt: The approved hand-painted character looks too dark after export. Its normal and roughness maps are tagged sRGB, the face has intentional mirrored UVs, and the artist requests a material-only correction.
evals.expected_output: Scoped asset corrections with current evidence, preserved project contracts and explicit unexecuted acceptance checks.
assertions: Separates target color-management and data-texture interpretation from changing the approved palette.
Preserves mesh, mirrored UV intent and rig while checking tangent or bake exceptions.
Checks saved texture files and affected export or states that target-engine validation remains unavailable.
Supplies consistent-camera neutral and intended-light evidence without calling a file write visual approval.

evals.prompt: Review the blender materials and uv decisions in this supplied report only. Do not edit the .blend, install tools or generate new artifacts. It contains a successful export and an old beauty image but no images of the latest revision.
evals.expected_output: Read-only findings identifying the evidence gap and the concrete next verification needed.
assertions: Keeps source files unchanged and returns findings in the response.
Does not treat an old image or successful export as visual evidence for the current revision.
Names the missing current-revision evidence and feasible checks without inventing execution.

evals.prompt: Bake a painted modular prop with intentionally mirrored color UVs and unique normal details. The first map has dark projection leaks and bright seams when downsampled.
evals.expected_output: Concrete scoped workflow and evidence-backed findings for the stated production failure, with unexecuted checks explicit.
assertions: Separates unique bake correspondence from intentional color overlap.
Checks selection, active image, cage and tangent assumptions before repainting.
Saves/reloads maps and verifies seam padding at delivery mip size.
